author: smorgasburg
title: Calling all local artists for 2027 NYC vendor application flyer
content: Smorgasburg, through your eyes. Calling all local artists! We’re looking for a local illustrator or designer to create our 2027 NYC vendor application flyer! This is a paid commission, with full artist credit and the potential for many future collaborations. We want to see something different from our past flyers. Something unmistakably New York that captures the messy, human experience of eating here: hands making food, friends sharing a bite, cultures meeting across a counter. Your style, your perspective. Submit your portfolio or Instagram through the link in bio by November 10. A sketch is optional, but including one helps us understand your vision and may speed up our review—rough ideas are welcome. The final flyer, featuring the selected artist’s work, will be posted on November 20. Know someone we should see? Tag them below. Contact: link in bio.

author: mostafa_gawad
title: Hiring Vector Background Artists for animated series
content: WE’RE HIRING! – VECTOR BACKGROUND ARTISTS. JUMP ANIMATION is looking for talented Vector Background Artists to join our upcoming animated series project! Requirements: Strong skills in creating 2D vector backgrounds. Proficiency in Adobe Illustrator or Adobe Animate. Ability to match an established cartoon art style. Attention to detail and good artistic skills. Project Duration: 2–3 Months (Freelance). Send your CV and Portfolio to: jobs@jumpanimation.com or gawad26@gmail.com. You can also message us directly through Facebook! If you’re passionate about cartoon backgrounds and 2D animation, we’d love to hear from you!

author: philfalcowrites
title: PAID COMIC WORK: Apply for TRANSPHORIA anthology
content: PAID COMIC WORK: Apply to be a Writer or Artist in the next volume of Ringo Award-winning comic anthology: TRANSPHORIA! No previous experience required (we love working with industry veterans AND fresh faces). Absolutely no costs to apply/contribute. Paid work for accepted contributors. Creators retain rights to their stories! Application Deadline: December 21, 2026! Link in @philfalcowrites bio! Contact: link in bio.
